tool_args.rationale: The pilot has only five observations for a four-parameter coupled memory ODE, with the initial memory state also depending on the fitted time constant. The extra trajectory batch is warranted to improve identifiability before numerical fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five rows leave the four coupled parameters insufficiently constrained for reliable confirmation; the mechanism note calls for at least eight.
The trajectory batch directly addresses the coupled ODE's parameter-identifiability requirement.
The pilot signatures indicate history dependence and coupled transient lag, which these uncoupled models do not capture.
It does not resolve the memory ODE parameters.
